<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Insurance company" processRef="PROCESS" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="L_clerk" name="Claims handler">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>search</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>file</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>estimate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>plan</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="L_mgr" name="Claims manager">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>negotiate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>inform</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Car accident claim received" />
    <bpmn:task id="search" name="Search the Police Report in the Police Report database" />
    <bpmn:task id="file" name="Put the Police Report in a file together with the Claim Documentation" />
    <bpmn:task id="estimate" name="Calculate the initial claim estimate" />
    <bpmn:task id="plan" name="Create the Action Plan based on the Action Plan Checklist" />
    <bpmn:task id="negotiate" name="Negotiate a settlement on the claim estimate" />
    <bpmn:task id="inform" name="Inform the claimant of the outcome" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end" name="Claimant informed" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="search" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="search" targetRef="file" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="file" targetRef="estimate" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" sourceRef="estimate" targetRef="plan" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="plan" targetRef="negotiate" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" sourceRef="negotiate" targetRef="inform" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" sourceRef="inform" targetRef="end" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
